title: 质数幻方企业主体 MCP 对接配置
description: 填写您在质数幻方官网生成的 API Key。凭证由 WorkBuddy 仅存储在本机用户目录，用于连接质数幻方企业主体 MCP 服务。
description_en: Enter the API Key generated on the Prime Matrix website. WorkBuddy stores it only in the local user directory and uses it to connect to the Company MCP service.
docLabel: 如何获取质数幻方 API Key？
docLabel_en: How to get a Prime Matrix API Key?

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 登录质数幻方官网 → MCP 产品 → 密钥 → 生成并复制密钥
fields.placeholder_en: Sign in to Prime Matrix → MCP Product → API Keys → Generate and copy a key
fields.description: 用于通过 Authorization: Bearer 请求头访问质数幻方 MCP 服务。
fields.description_en: Used to access the Prime Matrix MCP service through the Authorization: Bearer header.
